newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle off $1 at $109/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle off $1 at $109/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were near steady; dressed basis $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said. Buyer inquiry fairly good. Seller interest modest. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1300 lbs - 68.00 live - dressed basis 109.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 950-1200 lbs 68.00 live; dressed basis 109.00.
For week - 10,200 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 63,700 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 33,600
